intro: Reviewing is where your reviewers score submissions before you make decisions. You'll design a review form, recruit and assign reviewers, open reviewing, then keep an eye on progress — stepping in where a review needs chasing or finishing.

start.why: Everything else in this stage hangs off the review form, so build it first.
